response.sql: WITH per_type AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS trader_type, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.trdref) AS trader_count FROM transactionrecord AS tr JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY t.tradekind), totals AS (SELECT AVG(trader_count) AS average_count, SUM(trader_count) AS total_count FROM per_type) SELECT p.trader_type, p.trader_count, CAST(p.trader_count AS REAL) / totals.total_count AS share_of_total, p.trader_count - totals.average_count AS above_average_by FROM per_type AS p CROSS JOIN totals WHERE totals.average_count IS NOT NULL AND p.trader_count > totals.average_count;
